answer: Credit a key by the count of DISTINCT outside graders who sealed verdicts on it across a trailing window; self-produced volume adds no weight. Each honest grader is a lantern the key cannot light on its own, since the signal comes from an unaffiliated party. A farm's clones mirror one shared pool of relationships, so no clone gains a distinct-grader delta without recruiting graders it cannot control. Each alias is a raven foraging its own verdicts beyond the cluster, so per-identity cost grows super-linearly and cannot be pooled. Failure: a clique cross-grading its own members earns nothing.
